sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.2 "OPAMP pins and internal signals" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 728.
sections.section_content:
Table180 shows the pins used by the OPAMP peripheral. Their names correspond to the
configuration for use as inputs or outputs. Refer to Section24.3 for the assignment of each
to an I/O.
[Table 180. OPAMP pins]
Caution: The input and output pins connected, through the OPAMP multiplexers, to the operational
amplifier terminals INP, INM, and OUT must be configured in analog mode (default state),
through the corresponding GPIOx_MODER register.
Table181 lists the OPAMP internal signals. Refer to Section24.3 for pthe ossible
connection of each to internal resources and for specialization of the signal name.
[Table 181. OPAMP internal input/output signals]
